# Track Hair

> Track Hair is an iOS app that helps women and men track hair loss treatments over months — treatment schedules, repeatable progress photos, regimen notes, and long-term review checkpoints. It is a tracking journal, not a diagnostic service or a one-off AI scanner.

Track Hair is built for the months-long reality of hair loss treatment. Instead of judging progress from memory or daily mirror checks, users keep a stable routine (minoxidil, finasteride, spironolactone, microneedling, PRP, red light therapy, transplant recovery, or custom regimens), capture repeatable photos, and review meaningful intervals against a baseline. AI-assisted visible-change checks are offered as an informational reference only, alongside photos, notes, and clinician guidance.

Publisher: Darren Tracey. Platform: iOS. Price: free to download.
Medical note: Track Hair is informational only and does not provide diagnosis or treatment. Treatment decisions should be made with a qualified clinician.

## App
- [Download Track Hair on the App Store]({{ site.data.app.app_store_url }}): Free iOS hair loss tracker for women and men.
